stars: The flag's field or stripes have a star (a pointed shape, such as a five-pointed star). Stars found only inside a coat of arms also count.
cross: A cross as a main design of the flag (including Nordic crosses, the Swiss cross, a cross in one section of the flag as on Greece's flag or the Union Jack, and diagonal crosses like Jamaica's). Small crosses inside a coat of arms do not count.
crescent: The flag has a crescent moon, including one inside a coat of arms.
sun: The flag has a sun (a circle with rays, or a circle officially described as the sun). This includes Japan's Hinomaru and suns inside a coat of arms.
animal: The flag shows a living thing, such as an animal, bird, or insect (including inside a coat of arms).
unionjack: Part of the flag is the flag of the United Kingdom (the Union Jack). The United Kingdom itself also counts.
vtricolor: Three vertical bands in three colors (an emblem in the middle is OK).
htricolor: Three horizontal bands in three colors (bands of different widths or an emblem are OK).
redwhite: The only colors used are red and white (including any coat of arms).
